articles.summary: You may already have millions of AI traces from your agents, but what's actually broken? Confident AI Monitor classifies and grades every trace as it lands, turns failures into ranked issues, and hands you the root cause, the evidence, and a tested fix.
articles.title: Introducing Confident Monitor
